summary: This ESLint configuration file sets up rules for JavaScript and JSX files in the frontend of a DBMS application, including React hooks and React refresh.
evidence: The file imports ESLint rules for JavaScript and JSX files.
It specifies the files to be linted and their language options, including ECMAScript version and JSX support.
It configures ESLint to use the recommended rules from the `eslint-config-js` and `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` packages.
It includes custom rules, such as `no-unused-vars` and `react-refresh/only-export-components`, to enforce specific coding standards.
The `react-refresh/only-export-components` rule is set to warn, allowing constant exports.
